subject: Seat swap credit & renewal window request — Outreach licensing
messages:
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@outreach.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-15T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Seat swap / credit window request for Outreach renewal

Hi Sarah —

We’re approaching our Outreach renewal and I wanted to surface a proposal that could make the commercials easier for our finance calendar. Our existing contract renews 2026-11-01, but we have a couple of internal moves coming up: a partial reorg between SDR and AE teams that will shift ~50 seats from SDR to AE usage, and a likely reduction of ~20 pooled seats once we complete a headcount pause in Q1.

Ask: would Outreach consider a short, one-off credit or pro-rated swap window that lets us reassign seats without being charged for the unused seats during a 60–90 day transition? Ideally: 1) maintain current rates if we sign by 2026-10-15, 2) allow a phased seat swap (see bullets below) with a credit for seats taken out of active rotation for up to 90 days, and 3) include a 30-day rollback in case adoption stalls.

Phased suggestion (high level):
- Nov 1: reassign 30 SDR seats to AE pools (no net seat increase).
- Dec 15: evaluate usage; return up to 20 seats to the pool if not required.
- Jan 15: finalize headcount-based true-up.

I’ve attached a rough migration checklist. Marissa / Ben — looping you in for budget/ops constraints.

If Outreach can provide a simple addendum covering the credit and rollback language, we can route to procurement and get a PO within the next 3 weeks.

Thanks,
Aditya
Director, GTM Ops
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@outreach.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@outreach.io
Date: 2026-09-16T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seat swap / credit window request for Outreach renewal

Hi Aditya —

Appreciate the context and the clear timeline. We can be flexible here but need to align on a few guardrails: credits are typically applied as pro-rata credits against the next invoice, and the rollback window needs to be clear so seat reassignments are reversible without double-billing.

What we can offer today:
- Hold current pricing through 2026-10-15 if a signed PO or DocuSign is returned by then.
- Offer a one-time pro-rated credit for up to 20 unused seats over a 60-day observation window; crediting will be based on average monthly seat utilization over that window.
- Provide a 30-day rollback option (technical and seat admin support included) for any seats moved between SDR/AE pools.

I’ll attach our Q4 pricing worksheet and a template addendum for the credit language. If you want a >20-seat credit (or a guaranteed 90-day period) I’ll need to run that by legal and finance; happy to do so if you can indicate the exact seat counts and expected timing.

Sarah
Enterprise Sales Rep
Outreach

Attachments: pricing-sheet-outreach-Q4.xlsx, draft-mpa.docx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@outreach.io>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-17T08:27:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seat swap / credit window request for Outreach renewal

Thanks, Sarah — that’s helpful. Quick clarifications and a slight modification to the ask: we’re comfortable with the 60-day observation window, but can you confirm whether the credit calculation would use billed seats vs active seat logins? For our case we’d prefer active seat utilization (monthly active users) as the numerator for the pro-rata calculation.

Updated ask (binding items we need in addendum):
- Price hold through 2026-10-15 on the current rate if signed by that date.
- Credit: pro-rated based on monthly active users, up to 25 seats for 60 days.
- Rollback: 30 days with automated seat reallocation and admin support.
- Phased execution plan with two checkpoints (Dec 15 and Jan 15) and one final true-up.

Operational notes:
- Ben — finance will need the exact PO amount and expected cashflow impact if we accept the credit window.
- Marissa — ops will own the seat reassignments and will need an Outreach onboarding support slot the week of Nov 8. I attached a migration checklist to this thread.

If this is acceptable I’ll ask procurement to prepare the PO and route to you.

Aditya

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-18T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seat swap / credit window request for Outreach renewal

Quick note from finance: we can absorb a small timing difference but need the following before we sign: 1) an estimate of the credit amount (USD) so we can model cashflow, 2) a confirmed PO window (preferred by 2026-10-10 to hit internal cutoffs), and 3) DocuSign-ready addendum so we don’t lose time on redlines.

I’ll author a short memo for procurement once Aditya confirms the final seat counts.

Ben
VP Finance (acting)
Redwood Inference

From: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@outreach.io>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@outreach.io
Date: 2026-09-21T09:22:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seat swap / credit window request for Outreach renewal

Aditya —

We can accept the MAU (monthly active users) basis for the pro-rata credit and increase the seat cap to 25 for the 60-day window. Based on your current seat count and usage history, preliminary credit estimate is ~$18,400 (applied as a credit on the next invoice) assuming we observe a reduction of 20 seats across the period. I’ve attached an updated pricing sheet with the provisional calculation.

Also, we’ll include a 30-day rollback clause in the addendum and a short SOW for the migration support (no charge for the first 3 hours of admin reconfig). We can draft the addendum and send a DocuSign by end of day 2026-09-23 if that works — that will keep you inside the 2026-10-15 pricing hold if returned promptly.

Sarah
Attachments: pricing-sheet-outreach-Q4.xlsx

From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Kim <sarah.kim@outreach.io>, procurement@outreach.io
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Lauren Bishop <lauren_bishop@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-22T15:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Seat swap / credit window request for Outreach renewal

Thanks, Sarah — that estimate gets us close. Two quick asks before procurement signs: 1) can Outreach confirm the credit payback timing (which invoice the credit will land on) and 2) add a short bullet in the addendum that admin-led rollback won’t trigger any additional seat fees during the 30-day reversal.

We’ll proceed with procurement drafting the PO for the amount reflecting the pro-forma credit; Ben will share the memo this afternoon. Please send the DocuSign and the addendum language so we can review and route for signatures.

Appreciate the responsiveness here — looking forward to closing this in the next week.

Aditya
